gloss: as one wishes; just as one pleases; to one's heart's content

definitions.gloss: as one wishes; just as one pleases; freely and without restraint
definitions.explanation: Describes doing something exactly the way one wants, without interference or restriction. Can be used positively (freedom, self-expression) or negatively (selfishness, unchecked behavior).

examples.japanese: {思|おも}うがまま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|い}きる→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{思|おも}うがまま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{困|こま}らせた→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: He acted as he pleased and caused trouble for those around him.

examples.japanese: ⟦{退職|たいしょく}→退職：04559_taishoku⟧⟦したら→する：00392_suru⟧、{思|おも}うがまま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{過|す}ごしたい→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: After I retire, I want to spend my time traveling wherever I please.

notes:
The ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧まま pattern means "as is" or "in accordance with." {思|おも}うがまま literally means "as one thinks/wishes." Often followed by the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ to form an adverbial phrase ({思|おも}うがまま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧). The expression has a literary flavor and is common in written Japanese, speeches, and proverbs.

RELATED PATTERNS:
- {思|おも}うがまま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: as one wishes (adverbial)
- {思|おも}うがまま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do as one pleases
- {思|おも}うがまま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to go as one wishes; to be at one's disposal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{思|おも}い{通|どお}り→思い通り：25845_omoidoori⟧: as one expected; as one wanted — focuses on outcomes matching expectations
- ⟦{好|す}き{勝手|かって}→好き勝手：12239_sukikatte⟧: doing whatever one likes — more colloquial and usually negative
- ⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: freely — neutral, lacks the literary nuance
